breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting solver instructions: `time_integration: Explicit forward Euler` and a detailed `method: Strang splitting...`. The ground truth correctly resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' line entirely. The agent failed to do this; instead, it incorrectly merged the conflicting instructions into the phrase 'using Strang splitting with explicit forward Euler time stepping', which is not what the detailed method describes and perpetuates the original error.
